split.timestamp_policy: timezone-naive original clock, treated as a shared reference order; do not assert timezone is UTC
split.boundary_rule: TRAIN ts < dev_start, DEV dev_start <= ts < test_start, TEST ts >= test_start

unit.history: per-user strictly earlier eligible interactions, tie by stable source row
unit.availability: room.start <= target_start < room.end and room.author_id == event.author_id
unit.known_author: target author occurs in TRAIN eligible interaction set
unit.candidates: unique train-known authors with >=1 active room at pre-target ts; author-level full available roster
unit.missing_or_inconsistent: exclude with counts; never repair using observed TEST utility
unit.identity: live_id room check; author_id persistent relationship, no cross-release ID equality assertion

cohort.sampling: deterministic hash after eligibility, independent of target utility
cohort.hash_protocol: DuckDB 1.4.1 hash(user_id, author_id, live_id, timestamp_ms, source_event_id, seed) modulo 1000000

secondary_sampled_active.selection: fixed seed 20261012, 1 observed target + 574 distinct other eligible active authors
secondary_sampled_active.purpose: candidate-regime sensitivity, not a replacement for full-available confirmatory TEST

models.seed_rule: Run all additional seeds before invoking any across-seed stability claim; no outcome-driven seed stopping
models.hyperparameter_selection: DEV-only; same allowed budget per Base

memory.expert: fixed historical relationship Memory with unchanged prior paper components and weights

gates.model: HGB for three supervised objectives; same feature columns and grouped fivefold DEV-OOF
gates.threshold: pointwise DEV-OOF expected gain maximization subject to max DEV call-rate 30%; jointly tied scores all called or none

evaluation.multiple_testing: Holm over three one-sided primary comparisons
evaluation.equal_count_comparisons: posthoc ranking diagnostic only; not frozen serving policy

meta.caveat: This scientific intent lock precedes final executable cohort/sampler audit. Do not access TEST ranks before implementation and checkpoint manifests have been frozen.
